objects.name: New CitrixBleed Vulnerability Exploited Immediately After Public Disclosure
objects.description: Hackers are targeting NetScaler appliances using public PoC code to retrieve arbitrary memory content in the HTTP response. The post New CitrixBleed Vulnerability Exploited Immediately After Public Disclosure appeared first on SecurityWeek .
